g.text: Reasoning data pipeline
A small LLM for easy pairs, a bigger one for hard pairs, a VLM for QA data
PART II · GSU SIDE: REASONING ITEM ALIGNMENT
A · Filter item pairs (input: title + attributes only)
Item2Item Swing pairs
Qwen3-0.6B
10%+ rejected
User2Item two-tower pairs
Qwen3-8B
70%+ rejected
prompt (abridged)
Item-1: #Title, #Attributes … Item-2: #Title, #Attributes …
Analyze the potential correlation: semantic (similar concepts
or uses) or complementary purchase (bought or used together).
e.g. (fishing rod, parasol): highly related usage scenarios
Reply <answer>Yes</answer> or <answer>No</answer>.
B · Generate QA pairs per item
title, attributes, images, OCR, ASR
Gemini · Qwen2.5-VL-72B
ten diverse QA pairs per item, e.g.
Q: What is the item category?
A: Spicy food
Only questions the model can answer
confidently. Used for the generative loss.
Exploration pairs are mostly noise: 70%+ of User2Item pairs are rejected.
QARM V2 (arXiv:2602.08559), §3.1.1 (prompts, models, rejection rates) and Figure 3
